## Purpose

Describe the focused scientific or software change.

## Evidence

- [ ] Tests pass locally.
- [ ] Numerical changes include an independent check, invariant, or reference.
- [ ] Configuration and reproduction commands are provided.
- [ ] Documentation and scientific-scope statements are updated.
- [ ] No generated results, confidential data, or machine-specific paths are committed.

## Numerical impact

State expected differences in displacement, stress, force, convergence, runtime,
or memory. Write “none” for documentation-only changes.
